edges.reason: Both refer to the same AP-NORC poll with nearly identical figures (Nearly 70% vs Approximately 70%), reported in different articles.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, Al Jazeera reported “Approximately 70 percent of US adults in a new nationwide poll say the US-Israeli war has not been worth fighting, a five-point spike since July.”; on 2026-10-02, Al Jazeera reported “Nearly 70 percent of Americans now say the war has not been worth fighting, according to a new AP-NORC poll, with Trump brushing off the slide in his approval ratings by insisting “the pollsters are corrupt”.”.
